columns.name: ID
columns.description: Application unique identifier

columns.name: SUBMISSION_DATE
columns.description: Application submissions date

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Application current status

columns.name: APPLICANT_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: Applicant First Name

columns.name: APPLICANT_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Applicant Last Name

columns.name: APPLICANT_ADDRESS
columns.description: Applicant Mailing Address. Mailing address of the individual completing the application. The individual applying for the ADU pre-certification is not required to be the owner of the property.

columns.name: APPLICANT_UNIT
columns.description: Applicant Mailing Address Unit

columns.name: APPLICANT_CITY
columns.description: Applicant Mailing Address City

columns.name: APPLICANT_STATE
columns.description: Applicant Mailing Address State

columns.name: APPLICANT_ZIP
columns.description: Applicant Mailing Address Zip

columns.name: PROPERTY_OWNER_FIRST_NAME
columns.description: Property owner first name if applicant is not the property owner.

columns.name: PROPERTY_OWNER_LAST_NAME
columns.description: Property owner last name if applicant is not the property owner.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Project Address

columns.name: STREET_NUMBER
columns.description: Project Address Street Number

columns.name: STREET_DIRECTION
columns.description: Project Address Street Direction

columns.name: STREET_NAME
columns.description: Project Address Street Name

columns.name: UNIT
columns.description: Project Address Unit

columns.name: ZIP
columns.description: Project Address Zip Code

columns.name: WARD
columns.description: Project Address Ward

columns.name: ZONING
columns.description: Project Address Zoning Class

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: The latitude of the property

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: The longitude of the property

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the property in a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis on this data portal.

columns.name: COACH_HOUSE
columns.description: Indicates whether the application is for a coach house.

columns.name: LABOR_REQUIREMENT
columns.description: Acknowledgement of the labor requirement for coach house applications. Always 'Yes' for coach house applications.

columns.name: PRINCIPAL_BUILDING_REQUIREMENT
columns.description: Acknowledgement of the principal building requirement for coach house applications. Always 'Yes' for coach house applications.

columns.name: CONVERSION_UNIT
columns.description: Indicates whether the application is for a conversion unit.

columns.name: PRINCIPAL_BUILDING_BUILT_YEAR
columns.description: Year the principal building was built. Only applicable if applying for a conversion unit.

columns.name: DWELLING_UNITS_IN_LOT
columns.description: Number of dwelling units that are currently on the lot or will be on the lot once the principal building is constructed. Proposed ADUs are not included in this count.

columns.name: MAX_NUMBER_OF_ADU_ALLOWED
columns.description: Maximum number of conversion units allowed

columns.name: MAX_NUMBER_COACH_HOUSE_UNITS_ALLOWED
columns.description: Maximum number of coach house units allowed. Always 1 if applying for coach house.

columns.name: ADU_APPLYING_FOR
columns.description: Number of ADUs applying for.

columns.name: NUMBER_AFFORDABLE_UNITS_REQUIRED
columns.description: Number of affordable units required. For property owners adding two or more ADUs, half of the new ADUs (rounding down) must be rented to a tenant making 60% of the Area Median Income (AMI) or less, at a rate considered to be affordable.

columns.name: FEE_AFFORDABLE_UNITS_REQUIRED
columns.description: Fee required for affordable units

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGE_WILL_REQUIRE_AFFORDABLE_ADUS
columns.description: Acknowledge that the property will require affordable ADUs.

columns.name: ALDERMAN
columns.description: Name of the Alderman for the WARD at the time of submission.

columns.name: PROOF_OF_RESIDENCY_YN
columns.description: References if proof of residency documentation was attached to the application

columns.name: RECORDING_DEED_YN
columns.description: References if ADU Affordability Covenant was attached to the application.

columns.name: AFFIDAVIT_YN
columns.description: References if Annual Affordability Compliance Affidavit was attached to the application.

columns.name: PROPERTY_OWNER_YN
columns.description: Is the applicant the property owner?

columns.name: SUBMITTER_ROLE
columns.description: If not the property owner, then what is the role of the submitter?

columns.name: PROPERTY_OWNER_OCCUPIED
columns.description: Indicates whether the property is owner-occupied.

columns.name: ACKNOWLEDGE_NO_SHARED
columns.description: Acknowledgement that ADUs cannot be used for short-term leases or vacation rentals (e.g., Airbnb). Always 'Yes' unless the application was canceled before submission.

columns.name: HAS_ONE_APPLIED_PREVIOUSLY
columns.description: Indicates whether, to the submitter's knowledge, an ADU application has previously been submitted for this address.

columns.name: USER_AMENDED_DATE
columns.description: Date when the application was last updated or amended.

columns.name: ACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date when the current application status was assigned.
